import datetime
import pytest
from punch_validation import validate_punch

def test_valid_punch():
    result = validate_punch(
        employee_id=1,
        timestamp=datetime.datetime(2023, 1, 1, 9, 30),
        lat=12.9716,
        lng=77.5946,
    )
    assert result["valid"] is True
    assert result["reason"] == "Punch accepted"

import datetime
import pytest
from punch_validation import validate_punch

def test_location_out_of_range():
    # Approx. 200 meters north of the office coordinates
    result = validate_punch(
        employee_id=2,
        timestamp=datetime.datetime(2023, 1, 1, 12, 0),
        lat=12.9735,
        lng=77.5946,
    )
    assert result["valid"] is False
    assert result["reason"] == "Location out of range"

import datetime
import pytest
from punch_validation import validate_punch

def test_time_outside_window():
    result = validate_punch(
        employee_id=3,
        timestamp=datetime.datetime(2023, 1, 1, 5, 45),
        lat=12.9716,
        lng=77.5946,
    )
    assert result["valid"] is False
    assert result["reason"] == "Time outside allowed window"
